title: Kart race community event

facts.statement: Players were asked to bring a helmet, and a party was held outside the circuit for those not interested in racing.

article_summaries.title: Free Realms - What is New?
article_summaries.summary: A Spanish-language community event notice from the official Free Realms site, inviting players to a kart-racing gathering run by the Free Realms ambassador team at the Hojasilvestre race track. It gives two Server 1 session times, one for the Americas and Latin America and one for the UK and Europe, both in March 2011. The page does not give the post date, and the track's English name is not in the client text table.

quest_answers_mentioning_it: Kart Driver: SG Tour 400: Tangletrack (final, live yes)
